name: smwblocks-explode-bob-ombs-block
title: Explode Bob-Ombs Block
description:
This block makes Bob-Ombs explode when they touch it.
Uses Palette 7.

I also included defines that let you easily change how long the explosion will happen, how long to shake the screen and if you want the Bob-Omb to explode even when it gets carried, so make sure to check the asm file!

V1.1:
-The block no longer activates dead Bob-Ombs
-Moved the graphic to use last 8 colors of the palette row
-Added an option to disable exploding the Bob-Omb if it gets carried
